scientific_custody_notice: W-R43 reported high accuracy only with true original always first on heldout, creating a constant-first/orientation confound. Its prior numerical classification is retained historically but NOT accepted scientific evidence until a new order-balanced blinded trial. W-R44 single-candidate failure also motivates this control.
hypothesis: If W-R43's matched-pair advantage reflects real learned relative sequence information rather than a first-option bias, a pairwise comparator trained on new development pairs should classify both true-first and true-second heldout presentations above chance. Removing the intercept ensures mathematical reversal consistency; the original biased model can be evaluated alongside to measure orientation effects.
freeze: Before first use freeze fresh disjoint development seeds2336..2351 and sealed heldout2352..2367, exact W-R43 lag2 feature and paired sign-augmented training, fixed 32 perceptron epochs, LR0.1, 16 weights, identity-only development and identity/XOR55 heldout. Two orientation-balanced presentations per heldout original/swapped pair are ALWAYS evaluated, with tie half credit. Do not select best orientation, readout, threshold or eligible seed after observing outcomes.
arms: always_first_null: predicts first position is genuine regardless of sequence (must score exactly 50% across both orientations)
biased_original: paired-difference 16 weights plus trained bias exactly W-R43 fitting rule, both heldout candidate orderings evaluated
antisymmetric_no_bias: same 16-difference inputs and 1728 balanced signed development examples/32 epochs, but intercept frozen exactly zero, yielding exact sign reversal under candidate swap
outcomes: For each of 16 seeds/three generator families/two swap sites/9 entities per encoding, score both (true,altered) and (altered,true) presentations, count orientation-specific correct, incorrect and tied scores with 0.5 credit; explicitly report always-first null, biased and antisymmetric learning accuracy. For biased model separately record forward/reverse performance to expose one-sided bias.
classification: ORDER_BALANCED_RANK_SIGNAL iff antisymmetric no-bias heldout accuracy >=0.65 for both identity and XOR55 and at least +0.10 versus always_first baseline; PARTIAL_SIGNAL iff antisymmetric >=0.55 without strict criteria; NO_CONFIRMED_SIGNAL otherwise. Historical W-R43 forward-only result cannot satisfy this gate.
controls: No new training labels from sealed samples; true class used only by independent scorer and both orderings of each pair are always counted
16 model weights with no bias versus 16 weights+bias disclosed; both get 1728 balanced training examples and equal fixed 32 epochs; always-first null is a deterministic sanity baseline
No standalone sample-recognition claim, no new features, no privileged test-site identity to learner, no paired alternative fabrication
New first-use artifact followed by one complete Go regression/build, no replay of W-R43/W-R44 heldout, no accepted reference promotion
claim_limit: Fresh order-balanced synthetic two-alternative rank discrimination under known data construction, not single-candidate cognition, autonomous recurrent learning or broad general intelligence.
